rationale: The original thesis relied on a rejection from VWAP ($33.84) at $33.81 followed by immediate downward continuation, but price has instead reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($33.49) and pushed right back up to $33.80 (ask $33.82) as the broader market bounces (SPY recovering from -2.97% to -2.73%). With virtually zero favorable excursion (0.09% MFE) over 9 minutes and price consolidating directly underneath the recent bounce high and invalidation level, the expected downside momentum has failed to materialize. Closing now preserves capital ahead of a likely stop-out at $33.90.
